faqs.question: What is the difference between an LLC and an S-Corporation, and which is right for me?
faqs.answer: An LLC is a flexible state-level legal entity providing personal liability protection. An S-Corporation is a tax status elected with the IRS (via Form 2553) that can apply to your LLC. Once your business net profit surpasses approximately $60,000–$80,000 per year, an S-Corp election can save thousands of dollars annually by splitting income into a reasonable W-2 salary and distributions—avoiding self-employment taxes (15.3%) on the distribution portion. Mohasib Financial Group models your exact profit and handles the complete formation and election process.

faqs.question: How quickly can you get our business onboarded and catch up on overdue books?
faqs.answer: Standard onboarding takes 3 to 5 business days. We connect to your bank feeds (read-only) and existing accounting software with zero disruption to your daily operations. If you are months or years behind on bookkeeping or tax filings, our team specializes in historical catch-up reconciliation to get your books compliant, reconciled, and ready for taxes within 10 to 14 business days.

faqs.question: What tax deadlines should my business keep on its radar?
faqs.answer: Key federal business deadlines include: March 15 for S-Corporations (Form 1120-S) and Partnerships (Form 1065); April 15 for C-Corporations (Form 1120) and Individual 1040 returns; and quarterly estimated tax deadlines on April 15, June 15, September 15, and January 15. When you work with Mohasib Financial Group, we monitor all 50-state and federal calendars and prepare estimated vouchers well in advance so penalties never hit your cash reserves.

faqs.question: How do you handle client data security and confidential tax documents?
faqs.answer: We enforce bank-grade security protocols. Every document, tax return, and payroll record is stored in our proprietary Mohasib Vault™ secured with 256-bit AES encryption, two-factor authentication (2FA), and strict access controls compliant with IRS Publication 4557 guidelines for safeguarding taxpayer data.

faqs.question: Do I have to switch from my current accounting software?
faqs.answer: No. While we recommend and are certified in QuickBooks Online and Xero for maximum efficiency, we seamlessly integrate with your existing platforms, credit card processors (Stripe, Square, PayPal), and inventory systems to minimize migration friction.

faqs.question: What is required for the new FinCEN Beneficial Ownership Information (BOI) filing?
faqs.answer: Under the Corporate Transparency Act, most domestic LLCs and corporations formed in the U.S. must submit a Beneficial Ownership Information report to FinCEN identifying individuals who own at least 25% or have substantial operational control. Failure to file can carry severe civil penalties. Mohasib Financial Group prepares and e-files your BOI reporting accurately and securely.

faqs.question: How does your pricing work, and are there hidden fees?
faqs.answer: We believe in 100% price transparency. Our services operate on fixed monthly or flat-project rates established upfront in our engagement agreement. You will never receive an unexpected bill for a quick phone call, email question, or standard ledger reconciliation.

faqs.question: Can Mohasib Financial Group handle multi-state businesses?
faqs.answer: Yes. We advise clients with operations, remote employees, and sales tax nexus across all 50 U.S. states. We manage state payroll withholdings, state corporate income tax apportionment, and local annual report filings.
